thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — saw a spike in prefix-cache evictions on prod gpt-infer pool during the 14:00 UTC window.
Maya: ugh, saw that on the dashboard too. hit rate dropped ~10% for ~12m. link: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/dashboards/prefix-cache?range=2h
Alex: throwing the numbers here from the quick query:
```
evict_count: 124000
hit_rate: 0.783
fragmentation_score: 0.32
p50_latency_tokens: 12ms
```
Kevin: can someone kick off a kv-prof sampling run? need kv key access patterns + size histogram.
Maya: yep, please run: `./tools/kv-prof --svc gpt-infer --since 2026-03-16T13:40Z --duration 20m --sample 5000`
Kevin: starting now, will post flamegraph and top-keys. (will use --preserve-prefixes)
SRE Bot: perf job started: job_id=kj-20260316-7782, queued on node gpu-7
Kevin: quick FYI, noticed a small config tweak in last deploy that may affect eviction thresholds — checking PRs.
Jess: which tweak? we only touched batch sizing I thought.
Sam: the change was in runtime-config PR #4321 — eviction_threshold reduced from 0.7 to 0.6 to free up RAM for larger kv entries.
Alex: that aligns with the timing — 14:00 deploy was the one that landed #4321.
Maya: ok that could explain the lower hit rate (more aggressive evictions). but fragmentation jump is weird. could be key size variance.
Kevin: profiling done — attaching top results:
- top 5 prefixes by footprint: `user_ctx/`, `dialog/`, `system/`, `cache/emb/`, `temp/`
- 60% of evicted bytes came from `user_ctx/` (many large sequences)
Flamegraph link: https://perf-storage.redwood/fg/kj-20260316-7782
Alex: nice. does the profiler show old K/V layout fragmentation or frequent small writes?
Kevin: mix of both — many small writes interleaved with occasional huge inserts causing fragmentation. sample snippet shows many keys sized >120KB.
Maya: proposal: revert eviction_threshold to 0.7 for the pool, then run an aggressive compaction pass on shard group 3 overnight. We can also add a temporary prefix-size cap to prevent single keys from evicting many smaller hot keys.
Jess: +1 on prefix-size cap. what's the risk?
Maya: risk is slightly higher memory per-host until compaction finishes, but should keep hit rate up. rollback of threshold is low-risk.
Sam: I'll open a quick ops-change with rollback + compaction steps and ETA. tagging infra-oncall.
Alex: also add a short-lived alert: if hit_rate < 75% for >5m, page oncall.
SRE Bot: alert rule created: prefix_cache_hitrate_low (threshold=0.75, window=5m)
Kevin: I'll draft the small PR for prefix-size cap + unit tests, pinging @Maya for review.
Maya: pinged. will review in the morning.
Alex: thanks all. action items: Sam opens ops-change (#ops-209), Kevin PR for cap (#PR-4589), Maya schedules compaction job. We'll monitor the alert and reconvene if it fires. :thumbsup:
Sam: noted, adding runbook steps to the change.
Kevin: pushing PR in ~30m.
Jess: thanks — can someone drop the exact flamegraph link in the ops-change ticket? helps postmortem later.
Alex: will do. end.
